chatJumpButton.Name: ↓ button to the latest message

sustainChecker.Name: Sustain reminder
sustainChecker.Hint: Asks each turn whether to sustain a spell. Replaces pf2e-sustain-reminder.

hudEnabled.Name: Show character HUD

hudEffectSize.Name: Condition/effect icon size (px)

hudEffectsWidth.Name: When there are many effects
hudEffectsWidth.Hint: Effects never stretch the quick slots.

hudEffectDurations.Name: Show effect time left
hudEffectDurations.Hint: Shows the time left on effect icons as a ring and a short label.

hudReactionPip.Name: Show reaction next to the action pips

hudSaveCard.Name: Post a DC card with saving throws
hudSaveCard.Hint: HUD saving throws also post a DC (10 + modifier) card.

hudAutoInfused.Hint: Puts infused items in empty quickslots and clears them when gone.

hudSlotCard.Hint: Hover a quickslot to see its cost, traits and description.

paletteOpacity.Name: GM palette opacity
paletteOpacity.Hint: Becomes opaque when you hover over it.

tokenTipDistance.Name: Show distance on token hover

reactionChecker.Name: Reaction alerts

playersListMode.Name: Players list
playersListMode.Hint: Click the folded icon to peek at the list.

portraitScale.Hint: The largest size. On a short screen they shrink automatically so they don't overlap.

portraitBottomMargin.Hint: Increase it if the bottom portraits are covered.

portraitImage.Hint: Token art can look small. For actor portraits, a square transparent 512×512 is best.

portraitHpNumbers.Hint: The HP bar is always shown. Choose who sees the numbers.

portraitChatBubbles.Name: Chat speech bubbles

whisperPolicy.Hint: Who players can whisper. Applies to typed “/w” too.

chatShowUser.Hint: Shows the real player's name in small type under the character's name.

chatAvatars.Name: Show chat portraits
chatAvatars.Hint: Shows the speaker's token/character image on the left of the chat card.

chatCardTheme.Name: Chat card tone
chatCardTheme.Hint: Dark cards are closer to Foundry's default theme.

chatHeadingFont.Name: Name / check line font
chatHeadingFont.Hint: Font used for character names and check description lines.

chatBodyFont.Hint: Chat message text only. “Default” follows the PF2e-KR font.

chatHideEditorMenu.Hint: Shortcuts like Ctrl+B and Ctrl+I still work.

typingShowKeeper.Name: Show the GM's typing too
typingShowKeeper.Hint: Shows players when the GM is typing too.

typingReserveHeight.Name: Typing line height (px)
typingReserveHeight.Hint: Height of the “typing” line. 0 hides it.

typingSelector.Name: Typing indicator selector (advanced)
typingSelector.Hint: CSS selector of other typing indicators to move into the reserved strip. Leave empty to move nothing.

voiceBridgeUrl.Hint: The bridge bot's address. The setup wizard fills it in.

voiceSetupMenu.Hint: Step-by-step voice bridge setup on a local PC or an Oracle server.

diagWatch.Name: Problem alerts

chatRescue.Name: Bring out stuck roll cards
chatRescue.Hint: Shows roll cards still hidden after 9 seconds.

windowMinButton.Hint: Adds a minimize button to every window's title bar. A double-click on the title bar folds it too.

elevRangedUp.Hint: Off (default): shooting from lower down changes nothing.

Setup.Title: Discord Voice Setup Wizard
Setup.ResetTip: Clears every answer and the connection settings and starts over
Setup.LocalDesc: On Windows. Just double-click one .bat file.
Setup.Server: On a server such as Oracle (pm2 + Caddy)
Setup.ServerDesc: One SSH paste and a few Caddy lines. Starts again after a reboot.
Setup.EitherWay: Either way, one GM's screen receives and relays to everyone. Players set up nothing.
Setup.RemoveSummary: To remove a bridge you installed on a server and start again
Setup.RemoveHint: Run the line below over SSH to remove the pm2 entry and the settings file (.env).
Setup.Guide2: Bot menu → Reset Token → paste the token below.
Setup.Guide3: OAuth2 → URL Generator: scope bot, permissions View Channels · Connect → invite the bot with the URL.
Setup.Guide4: Discord Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode on, then right-click the server and voice channel → Copy ID.
Setup.TokenHint: The token only builds the files and is never saved in the world.
Setup.SavedDialog: Saved {name}. If you saved it inside the module folder, double-click that file.
Setup.SavedFallback1: No save window here, so it went to Downloads. Move it into the module folder (above) and run it.
Setup.SavedFallback2: Find it with File Explorer (Win+E) → Downloads, or with Ctrl+J in the browser.
Setup.SavedFallback3: The save window is blocked on http://IP addresses; https or localhost is fine.
Setup.LocalGuide1: Use the button below to save start-voice-bridge.bat inside the module folder.
Setup.LocalGuide2: Double-click it. The first run takes 1–2 minutes to install the required files.
Setup.LocalGuide3: When the black window shows Joined voice channel, it worked. Keep that window open during the session.
Setup.SaveDirHint: Paste the path below into the save window's address bar, then Enter. Moved data folder? {path} inside it.
Setup.AutoStartSummary: To start it automatically whenever Windows starts
Setup.AutoStart2: Copy the saved start-voice-bridge.bat into the Startup folder that opens.
Setup.AutoStart3: To stop, delete the file from that folder.
Setup.LocalNote1: If Node.js is missing, its download page opens automatically. Install the LTS version, then run the file again.
Setup.LocalNote2: This file contains the bot token. Don't send it to anyone.
Setup.NodeSummary: First: does the server have Node.js and pm2?
Setup.NodeHint: Type node -v over SSH; if it shows v20 or later, skip this. Otherwise run the two lines below in order.
Setup.NodeModulesHint: Don't copy node_modules from your PC to the server. Step 3 installs server ones.
Setup.DomainHint: Filled in from the address you're using right now. Leave it if it's the domain you use to reach Foundry.
Setup.DataPath: Foundry data folder (on the server; leave it if unsure)
Setup.SshTitle: ① Run over SSH, one line at a time
Setup.SshHint: Paste one line at a time from the top; wait for each to finish.
Setup.CaddyTitle: ② Add to the Caddy config
Setup.CaddyHint: Change the block as below with sudo nano /etc/caddy/Caddyfile, then sudo systemctl reload caddy. Port 8787 can stay closed.
Setup.UpdateHint: A module update can remove .env and the installed files. If so, rerun steps 1–4 here.

Setup.LinkHint: Open the link manager; as each person speaks, press + by their ID and pick the user.

Setup.HowToLocalWhy: For security, a web page can't run programs on your PC.
Setup.HowToServerTitle: On a server it should already be running
Setup.HowToServer: After step 3, pm2 keeps the bridge running, even after a reboot.
Setup.HowToServerTrouble: Won't connect? Check the log over SSH with {logs}; if you changed Caddy, run sudo systemctl reload caddy.
Setup.ResetConfirm1: Clears wizard entries, bridge address and connection key; turns the voice link off.
Setup.ResetConfirm2: Discord ↔ Foundry user links stay. To remove a server bridge, see the first screen.
Setup.ResetDone: Voice link settings have been reset.
Setup.Danger1: Danger: anyone on the internet can read the .env file that holds the bot token.
Setup.Danger2: This server serves dot-files on the web. Reset the bot token now and block this file in your hosting settings.
Setup.Safe: Security check: the settings file (.env) can't be read from the internet.

Diag.MenuHint: Problems on this computer this session, by module, with what to do.
Diag.LostBody: The browser dropped the map's graphics (WebGL). Canvases this session: {n} (limit about 16).
Diag.LostHint: A reload brings it back at once. If it keeps happening, lower the performance mode in HUD settings → Diagnostics.
Diag.ManyContexts: {n} graphics canvases open (mostly {top}). More may break the map.
Diag.Rescued: Brought out a roll card that was stuck hidden
Diag.PlayerLost: {user}: map graphics lost (WebGL). A reload fixes it.

Why.NotInstalled: '{id}' isn't installed on the server — install it, or remove this file where it's used.
Why.Inactive: {id} is turned off, so its files aren't served — turn it on or change what uses this file.
Why.FileGone: {id} doesn't have this file — update it, or pick the file again where it's used.
Why.UserFiles: This file isn't in the server's '{folder}' folder — moved or named differently.

Tip.Lost: The map's graphics are lost. A reload brings them back.
Tip.NoAccel: Hardware acceleration is off ({gpu}). Enable it in browser System settings and restart.
Tip.Many: {n} graphics canvases open (mostly {top}). Past about 16, the map may drop.
Tip.Perf: Performance mode '{now}' → '{next}' eases the GPU load. This computer only.
Tip.Fps: Max FPS is {fps}. 30 keeps the graphics card less busy (this computer only).
Tip.Dsn: Failed Dice So Nice rolls hide cards ({rescued} rescued, {errors} errors). Turn on 'Immediately display chat messages'.
Tip.Rescued: Brought out {n} roll card(s) stuck hidden (automatically).
Tip.Unverified: This version isn't verified for Foundry v{gen} — check for an update, or turn it off for a while.
Tip.Missing: {n} files missing on the server — see 'Missing files' below. Why some sounds or pictures fail.
Tip.Case: Paths differ only in letter case. Linux servers care — match the real file name.
Tip.Percent: {n} file name(s) contain %, which breaks addresses — remove %, # and ?.
Tip.OldChat: Old chat grouping code is running (now: {version}). Press Ctrl+F5 to hard reload.
Tip.Mixed: {n} line(s) joined to another speaker's card. Please send the copied report.
Tip.Clock: This clock and {user}'s differ by about {s} s. On the wrong one: Windows Settings → Time → 'Sync now'.
Tip.Leaky: {name} made {n} canvases ({alive} alive). Update it, or turn that feature off here.
Tip.Released: Automatically let go of {n} abandoned graphics canvas(es).

Diag.Lead: Problems on this computer this session (since {time}). A reload starts the count again.
Diag.WebglHint: Graphics canvases opened by modules. Past about 16, the oldest are dropped.
Diag.PlayersHint: Players with lost graphics report automatically. 'Ask players' gets everyone's state now.
Diag.Copied: Report copied — paste it into Discord or anywhere.
Diag.Asked: Asked the players for their reports.
Diag.PerfChanged: Performance mode: {mode}. Reload to apply it fully.
Diag.DsnChanged: Dice So Nice now shows chat messages at once.
Diag.Speaker: Speaker
Diag.ChatHint: Last chat cards, screen order. ↳ joined above · red = joined with another person · yellow = order/time mismatch.
Diag.Released: Let go of {n} abandoned graphics canvas(es) (to spare the map)

Polyglot.Title: Polyglot: languages in use
Polyglot.Hint: Languages the chat's picker offers (GM only). Beside each: PCs who know it.

ChatEdit.Hint: Enter saves · Shift+Enter new line · Esc cancels

Cover.Title: Cover
Cover.BarHelp: Click: choose cover (Take Cover is 1 action)
Cover.lesserWhen: Another creature is in the way · AC only
Cover.standardWhen: Take Cover behind a wall, rock or tree · AC, Reflex (area), Stealth
Cover.greaterWhen: Take Cover while you already have cover · AC, Reflex (area), Stealth
Cover.lesserDesc: Lesser cover: +1 circumstance bonus to AC.
Cover.standardDesc: Standard cover: +2 circumstance bonus to AC, to Reflex saves against area effects, and to Stealth checks to Hide or Sneak.
Cover.greaterDesc: Greater cover: +4 circumstance bonus to AC, to Reflex saves against area effects, and to Stealth checks to Hide or Sneak.
Cover.EndsRounds: Ends after {n} rounds, at the start of your turn.
Cover.EndsMove: Ends when you move from your space.
Cover.EndsAttack: Ends when you use an action with the attack trait (Strike, spell attack, Grapple, Trip...).
Cover.EndsManual: To end it yourself: "End cover" in the cover menu.
Cover.EndedAttack: {name} used an attack action: cover ended.
